meta.name: Abdelhamid Attaby
meta.title: Senior Software Engineer
meta.tagline: Distributed Systems · Technical Leadership · AI & Agent Engineering

about: Senior software engineer with 15+ years building, shipping, and operating medium-to-large-scale applications, including two years at GitHub (Microsoft) contributing to one of the world's largest monolithic codebases. Since 2023, I've channeled that experience into startups and applied AI — co-founding an early-stage venture and serving as a founding engineer on a multi-agent AI application platform — building production agentic-AI products hands-on. Full-stack strength across Node.js, TypeScript, Ruby on Rails, React, Go, and Elixir, with deep experience in microservices, distributed systems, API design, and CI/CD, and a daily AI-assisted engineering practice. A proven technical leader — twice CTO — who has architected platforms, led engineering teams, and mentored engineers from early-career to senior. I hold M.Sc. and Ph.D. degrees in Computer Science and Engineering and am pursuing an MBA (AAST).

strengths.title: Distributed systems & APIs at scale
strengths.body: Built the GraphQL APIs behind GitHub Projects; ran performance work and data migrations across hundreds of millions of records.

strengths.title: Full-stack product engineering
strengths.body: A decade of production Node.js/TypeScript, React, Ruby on Rails, Go, and Python across fintech, healthcare, and developer tools.

strengths.title: Technical leadership
strengths.body: CTO twice, tech lead twice; hired, mentored, and ran engineering teams end-to-end, from architecture to delivery.

strengths.title: AI & agent engineering
strengths.body: Builds production agent workflows daily — autonomous research agents, scheduled tasks, tool integrations — and ships with LLM-assisted development.

bullets: Founding engineer on an AI application platform where a team of specialized AI agents plans, designs, builds, and ships production web apps end-to-end — each with a real backend, dedicated PostgreSQL database, and APIs.
Building the core product hands-on across an Elixir and TypeScript/Node.js stack: agent orchestration, LLM integration, and the services behind the multi-agent build-and-ship pipeline.
Engineering the system that turns natural-language product intent into deployed, production-ready applications with persistent project memory across sessions.

Co-founded an early-stage SaaS startup building a real-time visual feedback and collaboration platform — comment directly on live websites, videos, PDFs, and images, edit HTML/CSS in place, and auto-capture screenshots, delivered via web app and a Chrome extension.

Built the product end-to-end as one of two co-founders: Elixir backend services and proxy, JavaScript/React frontend and Chrome extension, a TypeScript screenshot service on AWS Lambda, all provisioned with Terraform.
Owned product and engineering direction across a multi-tenant SaaS; made the disciplined decision to wind the company down in late 2025, carrying the learnings directly into AI product engineering.
Built and shipped GitHub Projects — the planning-and-tracking experience used by organizations and developers worldwide — as part of the Memex team.

Contributed across the github/github monolith, one of the world's largest codebases, working with three engineering teams (Projects, Special Projects/Runtime, internal engineering documentation platform).
Delivered saved views, user-owned projects, the project GraphQL APIs, fast issues, the iterations field, and the issue sidebar.
Worked on large-scale performance, distributed data migrations, and platform reliability using Ruby on Rails, Go, React, TypeScript, and MobX.
Set engineering strategy and technical direction at a regional SaaS/website-building company, partnering with leadership on roadmap and execution.
Architected core platforms from the ground up and established engineering standards, delivery processes, and CI/CD.
Built and scaled the engineering team through hiring, mentoring, and code review.
Led the engineering team to deliver product requirements; set technical strategy and direction with leadership; owned the team budget and tooling.
Architected the backend on a microservices model and built APIs aggregating users' wealth into dashboards and charts.
Integrated numerous third-party financial APIs to extend platform capability.
Senior engineer for Simple Habit, Inc. (San Francisco), shipping a high-quality meditation product through engineering best practices.
Designed and conducted technical interviews for senior and principal candidates; mentored mid-level and senior engineers.
Led frontend and backend teams building and deploying the Grow Healthy platform, integrating multiple systems and APIs.
Integrated Twilio, OnFleet, Zendesk, and Google Maps; built order processing on Google Firestore, Scheduler, Pub/Sub, and Cloud Functions.
Authored unit and end-to-end tests with Jest; automated deployments with GitHub Actions.
Co-founded an EdTech company and designed the core architecture of its learning management system.
Directed cross-platform engineering across web, Android, and iOS through an Agile process.
Built fully automated CI/CD pipelines on CircleCI for containerized applications using Docker, Netlify, and AWS.
Led a team building enterprise Odoo (OpenERP) modules and a RESTful API server integrating Odoo with third-party applications.
Established team-wide engineering workflows and CI/CD pipelines on CircleCI using Docker and DigitalOcean.
Node.js Back-end Engineer (BeatFlyer, via Toptal, 2019): built RESTful APIs for a fleet-management platform with multiple authentication schemes and Jest coverage.
Software Engineer (So Visions, 2012–2014): developed accounting, purchasing, inventory, and sales modules of a full ERP system.
Software Engineer (Arabia Inform, 2011–2012): built backend crawlers using the Twitter Search and YouTube Data APIs.
